body: The key ring and bucket are packed together. Brown foam has dried on both, with a high-water line in the bucket. I think it's from a pasture treatment.
title: Key ring and bucket

body: A receiver still set to an emergency band, and a strip of pills. The road map has the county roads crossed out in one neat hand. The campers seem to have left before any closure was announced.
title: Receiver, map and pills
